assumptions: FY2027 is NVIDIA's 53-week year ending the last Sunday in January (Jan. 31, 2027); reported first-half FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS was $4.85 for the 26-week period ended July 26, 2026. Assumptions use a constant split-adjusted diluted-share approximation: bear $8.00 (remaining-half $3.15) models customer digestion, supply/China constraints, or lower margins; base $9.00 (remaining-half $4.15) models continued data-center demand without a claim of management guidance; bull $10.00 (remaining-half $5.15) models sustained demand and execution. P/E values 24x/26x/28x are explicit sensitivity assumptions, not observed multiples, fair values, consensus or probabilities.
